leadText: Galloping with Ponyta (Chinese: Braving the Snowstorm, Dashing towards Springtime ~ In Celebration of Lantern Festival, Let's Shine in the New Year with Ponyta!; Japanese: ポニータと駆ける Galloping with Ponyta) is a one-minute short based on the .
